name: Oathkeeper
description: You keep your word in a sector where contracts are written in rust and broken in vacuum.
effectSummary: Unlocks trust-based parleys and seals Cutthroat.

name: Cutthroat
description: You strip hulls before checking pulses. Sentiment is dead weight in the Drift.
effectSummary: Unlocks ruthless intimidation options and seals Oathkeeper.

name: Ghost
description: Sensors slide off your silhouette. You slip through ward-nets before anyone hears the hum.
effectSummary: Unlocks silent bypasses and seals Dread.

name: Dread
description: Syndicate patrols know the whine of your plasma coils—and scatter when they hear it.
effectSummary: Unlocks shock-and-awe dominance and seals Ghost.

name: Cold-Iron Purist
description: You trust riveted steel, grounded copper, and hard math over whispering ley-glass.
effectSummary: Resists anomaly bleed and seals Aether-Bound.

name: Aether-Bound
description: Your marrow hums at the same frequency as cracked monoliths and star-runes.
effectSummary: Unlocks deep harmonic attunements and seals Cold-Iron Purist.

name: Frontier Warden
description: You stake your boots in Siltport's dust and refuse to let the Syndicate tax the rim dry.
effectSummary: Inspires settlers and seals Lone Drifter.

name: Lone Drifter
description: Outposts are just fuel stops. Your only true allegiance is to an open throttle.
effectSummary: Sharpens independent grit and seals Frontier Warden.

name: Void-Touched
description: An aether backlash burned frost-blue capillaries into your forearm. You hear dead relays sing.
effectSummary: Stackable scar from surviving Resonance & anomaly mishaps.

name: Unbroken
description: Steel buckled, alarms screamed, and you stayed at the stick anyway.
effectSummary: Stackable scar earned by enduring brutal setbacks without fleeing.

name: Scrap-Savvy
description: You brought a bleeding hull home on a prayer and welded it whole with your own torch.
effectSummary: Stackable mastery earned by patching a battered ship with salvage.

name: Sigil-Scarred
description: Ozone and molten silver-wire live beneath your fingernails from splicing spells into hardware.
effectSummary: Stackable mastery earned by forging magi-tech synergies at the Workbench.
